from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, re, sys
root=Path.cwd()
base=root/'evaluation/task05'
sys.path.insert(0,str(base))
from make_review_packet import participant_text
names=['docs/TASK05_REPORT.md','docs/TASK05_REVIEW_PACKET.md','docs/SUBMISSION_READINESS.md','docs/DEVELOPMENT_STATE.md','evaluation/task05/README.md']
missing=[]; count=0
for name in names:
    file=root/name
    for link in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)',file.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
        if link.startswith(('https://','http://','#')): continue
        count+=1
        target=Path(link.split('#')[0].strip('<>'))
        target=target if target.is_absolute() else file.parent/target
        if not target.exists(): missing.append({'file':name,'link':link})
manifest=json.loads((base/'implementation-final-02.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
mismatches=[name for name,h in manifest.items() if hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=h]
packet=(root/'docs/TASK05_REVIEW_PACKET.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
responses={f'{side}/{q}':packet.count(participant_text(side,q)) for side in ('A','B') for q in ('q1','q2','q3')}
review=json.loads((base/'review-input/review-meta.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
finish=json.loads((base/'completion-observation.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
acceptance=json.loads((base/'acceptance-final.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
protected=all(not v['mismatches'] and not v['added'] for v in acceptance['protected'].values())
ok=not missing and not mismatches and all(v==1 for v in responses.values()) and protected and not acceptance['freeze']['mismatches'] and all(acceptance['historical_reports'].values()) and finish['status']=='TASK05_EVAL_READY_WITH_EXECUTION_GAP'
result={'at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'ok':ok,'local_links_checked':count,'missing_links':missing,'implementation_files':len(manifest),'implementation_mismatches':mismatches,'complete_response_occurrences':responses,'frozen_files_unchanged':not acceptance['freeze']['mismatches'],'protected_history_unchanged':protected,'historical_reports_unchanged':all(acceptance['historical_reports'].values()),'review_scores':review['validation']['scores'],'document_hashes':{name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in names},'acceptance':'acceptance-final.json','completion':'completion-observation.json','limits':'Local delivery integrity only; no fresh-host or ordinary-baseline execution implied.'}
with (base/'delivery-audit.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    json.dump(result,stream,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
